plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on clinical angles: ablation, anticoagulation, rate/rhythm control, LAA closure, stroke prevention, and evidence types (trials, metas, guidelines, registries). Deliberately skips basic science (genetics, animal models) and health economics. Assumes the reader's 'clinical focus' means prioritizing intervention studies and outcomes over mechanism research.
